observations: Photo 0: A disassembled V8 engine on a concrete floor in a storage/garage area, with 'PORSCHE' cast into the cylinder head covers.
Photo 1: Closer view of the same engine, showing the intake manifold, wiring harness, and a second partial engine block to the right.
Photo 2: Another angle showing the transmission bell-housing area attached to the engine, plus additional engine parts stacked in the background.
A watermark reading 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' appears across all three photos, indicating the seller's business branding, not an independent certification.
No engine code, VIN plate, or model sticker is legible in any photo.
No visible turbochargers, indicating this may be a naturally aspirated Porsche V8 (e.g., Cayenne/Panamera family), but this cannot be confirmed without a clearer shot of the block casting number.
No power cables, battery, or test rig is shown, so running condition cannot be observed.

Surfaces show grease, dust, and some corrosion on the transmission/bell-housing, consistent with a used take-out engine, but overall completeness (sensors, turbo lines, accessories) cannot be fully confirmed.

identity.kind: used V8 engine assembly (partial drivetrain, engine with bell-housing)

claims.claim: We also deals on all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim; no photo or document shown to confirm range of inventory or legitimacy of dealership.

risks.risk: Engine running/compression condition unknown (could be a dead or cracked block, since no start-up or compression test is shown).
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine being started and running, or a compression test reading shown on camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-running, for parts/rebuild only

risks.risk: Specific model/engine code (e.g., M48, MA1, or other Porsche V8 variant) cannot be confirmed, which affects compatibility and value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block casting number or ID tag/plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic 'Porsche V8 engine, model unconfirmed'

risks.risk: Completeness of accessories (turbo, sensors, ECU, wiring harness, starter, alternator) not verifiable from photos alone.
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos/video showing all sides of the engine with accessories attached.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, accessories not included

risks.risk: Possible internal damage (hidden from the exterior, e.g., bearing wear, bent rods) is undetectable from static photos.
risks.proof: Video of engine running, or borescope/teardown photos of internals.

risks.risk: Mileage or usage history is unknown, and 'low mileage' or 'tested' claims are not made or supported.
risks.proof: Odometer photo from the donor vehicle, or a dealer invoice with mileage stated.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown mileage, high-risk used part

proof_requests: Clear photo of the engine block casting number or VIN/ID plate to confirm exact model.
A video of the engine running or at least turning over, to assess condition.
Photos from all sides (front, rear, both sides, top, bottom) showing completeness of sensors, turbo, and wiring.
Any documentation (invoice, donor vehicle ownership papers) tying this engine to a specific Porsche model and mileage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used Porsche V8 engine assembly from the visible casting text, but without a running demonstration, model code, or completeness check, it must be priced at worst case as an untested, incomplete take-out engine.
